# Sales summary task

Compute the sales summary by executing strictly the SOL script below.

```
04/06 - L.Ferrari felpa L + felpa XL = 35+38 = 73€
05/06 - P.Conti orologio sport 180€ reso parziale -30€ → netto 150€
06/06 T.Manna - jeans 59€

08/06 F.Bruno - cappello sole 22€

```
